results.title: My Honest Review of ShareFile Alternatives (After the Sale) in 2026 — Peony
results.content:
Peony is the best ShareFile alternative for law firms that need secure client document sharing with audit-grade tracking. Peony's page-level analytics (free on every plan) show exactly which pages of a closing binder, disclosure schedule, or privilege log each party reviewed and for how long — critical for documenting that all parties had access to material information. The Business plan ($30/admin/month) adds screenshot protection, while the Data Room plan ($52/admin/month) adds dynamic watermarks and AI auto-indexing that organizes 1,000+ transaction documents into categorized folders in under 3 minutes and granular permissions for privilege walls. E-signatures for engagement letters and transaction closings are available on Business ($30/admin/month). [...] Pricing: Free tier available. Business plan: $30/admin/month; Data Room plan: $52/admin/month. No per-user scaling, no minimum user requirements, no storage overages. Viewers are always free.

Best for: M&A due diligence, fundraising, PE portfolio management, VC deal flow, commercial real estate, legal practices, accounting firms, consulting teams, and any team paying $50+/user/month for ShareFile's VDR tier.

## 2. Box — Best Enterprise Content Platform

Box is the enterprise content management platform that ShareFile aspires to compete with. While ShareFile serves 86,000+ customers, Box serves 100,000+ businesses including 69% of the Fortune 500. If your primary need is enterprise-grade content governance with deep integrations, Box is the strongest ShareFile alternative. [...] ## 8. Hightail — Best for Creative Workflows

Hightail (now under OpenText) is not a ShareFile competitor in the traditional sense — it is a creative workflow platform that happens to share files. If your team sends large design files, needs visual proofing with annotations, and runs approval workflows on creative assets, Hightail is purpose-built for that.

results.title: The Best ShareFile Alternative for Secure File Sharing | Egnyte
results.content:
Yes—Egnyte is integration-rich:

 Works natively with Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, Trello, and dozens of SaaS apps.
 Open APIs and app marketplace for developing customized workflows and deeper business automation.
 Streamlined connection to file-sharing networks, CRM, and ERP systems, often exceeding ShareFile’s integration options. [...] Secure document portals, Virtual Data Rooms (VDRs), and external file sharing with audit logging and folder-level encryption.
 Customized branding: Create a professional interface for client interactions.
 Granular permission controls: Manage who sees, edits, or downloads files.
 Support for compliance: Automate consent, approvals, and document collection for regulated industries.
 Security Protection at Its Core Protect against suspicious logins to your environment, and address potential threats by organizational insiders.

Both platforms offer enterprise-grade encryption and compliance, but Egnyte expands on this with: [...] Egnyte: Pricing starts at $20/user/month, with options for flexible storage and usage tiers, and supports customized enterprise plans. Hybrid deployment can optimize costs for teams with on-premises data.
 ShareFile: Leans toward enterprise-tiered pricing, often higher starting costs , especially for their Virtual Data Room, which starts at $75/user/month, and focuses its model on cloud usage.
 Egnyte’s flexible scaling and customized deployment can make it more cost-effective for hybrid and compliance-sensitive environments.
